leadText: (Japanese: ポケットモンスターダイヤモンド&パール Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl) is a series created by 坂井 孝行 Sakai Takayuki. It is based on Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl, and the stories feature and 's adventures. Unlike other manga adaptations of , Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl features original stories rather than adaptations of the plotlines of specific episodes.
